records.name: Safety Gate v1
steps: Collect the defined safety inputs.
Route RED or unresolved YELLOW states away from automated training handoff.
Keep the Safety Gate result separate from performance values.
stop_conditions: Stop automated handoff when the Safety Gate blocks it.
retest_requirements: Re-run when relevant safety inputs change.

records.name: SportRX Hybrid Benchmark v1 - Standard path
records.scope: Measurement session using the documented standard-equipment component protocols.
steps: Confirm Safety Gate handoff and selected protocol version.
Record component results in raw units with equipment and substitutions.
Capture post-component RPE and session notes.
Save incomplete components as Not tested.
equipment: Documented standard Benchmark equipment when available
stop_conditions: Apply the documented component and global stop rules.
Stop when the participant reports a concerning symptom or cannot safely continue.
records.rpe_capture: Capture component or session RPE using the app's documented scale.
retest_requirements: Use the same component protocol, equipment, unit and comparable setup before interpreting change.

records.name: SportRX Hybrid Benchmark v1 - Low-equipment path
records.scope: Measurement session using the documented low-equipment component protocols.
steps: Confirm Safety Gate handoff and low-equipment path.
Record each completed component in its original raw unit.
Capture RPE, route, surface, equipment and deviations.
Leave unavailable components as Not tested rather than estimating them.
equipment: Low-equipment alternatives specified by the Benchmark protocol
stop_conditions: Apply the documented component and global stop rules.
Stop when the participant reports a concerning symptom or cannot safely continue.
records.rpe_capture: Capture component or session RPE using the app's documented scale.
retest_requirements: Repeat with the same low-equipment protocol, route or surface where relevant, unit and setup.

records.name: SportRX Retest v1
records.scope: Like-for-like comparison after a completed training block.
steps: Confirm a prior Benchmark record and protocol version.
Repeat only comparable completed components.
Record protocol deviations, RPE and contextual notes.
Keep non-comparable results as context rather than interpreting change.
equipment: Match baseline equipment and setup where possible
stop_conditions: Use the same stop rules as the baseline component protocol.
records.rpe_capture: Record RPE with the same documented scale as baseline.
retest_requirements: Same protocol version or explicit documented deviation.
No conversion of missing or non-comparable data into change scores.

records.name: SportRX 1 km run record v1
records.scope: Raw 1 km running record with route or treadmill context.
steps: Choose a measured route or treadmill and record the test context.
Complete the recorded 1 km test without converting it to another test type.
Record raw time and RPE.
stop_conditions: Apply global stop rules and stop for concerning symptoms or unsafe pain.
retest_requirements: Keep test type, route or treadmill, surface, incline, warm-up, timing method and unit the same.
Do not compare directly with 6-minute results.
records.limitations: Partial evidence only: the direct adult evidence is a 1,000 m walk-run protocol and does not validate SportRX hard-run conditions, norms or scores.

records.name: SportRX 6-minute run/walk record v1
records.scope: Low-equipment raw 6-minute distance record with explicit run or run/walk variant.
steps: Select and record the test variant before starting.
Complete six minutes on the documented route or treadmill.
Record raw distance and RPE; do not convert to a 1 km time.
stop_conditions: Apply global stop rules and stop for concerning symptoms or unsafe pain.
retest_requirements: Keep test variant, route or treadmill, surface, incline, warm-up, timing method and unit the same.
Do not compare directly with a 1 km test.
records.limitations: Partial evidence only: direct adult evidence supports a standardized continuous run, not unrestricted SportRX run/walk, and no reference values are imported.

records.name: SportRX RowErg / SkiErg 1 km record v1
records.scope: Device-specific raw 1 km ergometer time record.
steps: Select RowErg or SkiErg and record device model and drag factor or setting.
Record warm-up, familiarization and test order before testing.
Record raw time and RPE without cross-machine conversion.
stop_conditions: Apply global stop rules and stop for concerning symptoms or unsafe pain.
retest_requirements: Keep erg type, model, setting, warm-up, familiarization, order and timing method consistent.
Do not compare RowErg with SkiErg or assign a norm.
records.limitations: Partial evidence only: available studies are device-, distance- and population-specific. SportRX has no cross-machine conversion, norm or meaningful-change threshold.

records.name: SportRX station circuit experimental record v1
records.scope: SportRX experimental station-circuit raw record for standard and low-equipment paths.
steps: Define movements, loads, sequence, rest rule and permitted substitutions.
Record rounds or raw time without creating a derived score.
Record RPE and all deviations.
equipment: Documented station equipment or low-equipment alternatives
stop_conditions: Apply global stop rules and stop for concerning symptoms, unsafe pain or unsafe technique.
retest_requirements: Keep movement standard, loads, sequence, rest rule, substitutions, warm-up, familiarization and order the same.
Treat changes as contextual raw records.
records.limitations: Experimental SportRX protocol. It has no direct validation, reliability estimate, minimal-change threshold, normal range, aggregate score or event-prediction meaning.

records.name: SportRX compromised-run experimental record v1
records.scope: SportRX fatigue-after-circuit running or transition raw record.
steps: Document the exact preceding circuit or transition block.
Record route or treadmill context and raw result.
Record RPE and all deviations without a derived fatigue score.
stop_conditions: Apply global stop rules and stop for concerning symptoms, unsafe pain or unsafe technique.
retest_requirements: Keep the preceding circuit, route or treadmill, surface, incline, timing method, warm-up, familiarization and order the same.
Treat changes as contextual raw records.
records.limitations: Experimental SportRX protocol. It has no direct validation, fatigue index, reliability estimate, minimal-change threshold, normal range or event-prediction meaning.
